caseName: United States v. Alcea Band of Tillamooks
caseNameFull: United States v. ALCEA BAND OF TILLAMOOKS

opinions.text:
Certiorari granted, by the Supreme Court November 6, 1950, limited to -the first question presented by the petition for the writ, i. e.:

' Whether the respondents aré entitled to interest since 1855 on the value of the tribal lands. This- depends on whether their claimed compensation rests on -the Constitution or on the Special Jurisdictional Act.
